title: Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
description: Als Business Development Manager (m/w/d) bei Enpal Financial Solutions arbeitest Du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Partnergeschäft erfolgreicher und skalierbarer machen? Du kombinierst analytisches Denken, Business Development und kommerzielles Verständnis und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen. Deine Ideen sollen nicht nur auf dem Papier funktionieren – Du bringst sie in die Umsetzung und misst ihren tatsächlichen Impact. Du untersuchst, warum bestimmte Partner erfolgreicher sind als andere und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen und Best Practices ab. Du entwickelst neue Ansätze, um die Nutzung unserer Finanzierungslösung bei Partnern zu steigern. Du erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und gehst diese proaktiv an. Du denkst über einzelne Partner hinaus und entwickelst Lösungen, die auf größere Teile unseres Partnernetzwerks übertragbar sind. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Umsetzung Deiner Ideen und misst deren Erfolg. Analytics & Problem Solving Du nutzt Daten und KPIs, um komplexe Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und relevante Insights zu gewinnen. Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund und fragst Dich nicht nur „Was passiert?“ , sondern vor allem „Warum passiert es?“ und „Was können wir verändern?“ Du übersetzt Analysen in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen. Du erkennst Zusammenhänge und Muster und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungsansätze. Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Möglichkeiten, unser Partnergeschäft effizienter und skalierbarer zu machen. Du kannst zwischen Detailtiefe und strategischer Perspektive wechseln. Partner & Commercial Ownership Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Installateur-Partnern auf und verstehst deren Geschäftsmodelle und Vertriebsprozesse. Du bist Sparringspartner für Deine Partner und hilfst ihnen dabei, konkrete Business-Ziele zu erreichen. Du kannst analytische Erkenntnisse in überzeugende Empfehlungen übersetzen und unterschiedliche Stakeholder für Veränderungen gewinnen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität und bist bereit, selbst in die Umsetzung zu gehen. Zusammenarbeit & Aufbau Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen. Du bringst Deine Erkenntnisse in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und unseres Partnerangebots ein. Du hilfst dabei, Best Practices und skalierbare Strukturen aufzubauen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für neue Themen und treibst sie eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Du wartest nicht darauf, dass für jedes Problem bereits ein Prozess existiert. Das bringst Du mit Du hast erste Berufserfahrung in Business Development, Consulting, Strategy, Sales, Key Account Management, Commercial Operations oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld. Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte analytische und unternehmerische Denkweise . Du hast Spaß daran, komplexe Probleme zu strukturieren und aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten. Du denkst proaktiv, erkennst Chancen und möchtest Dinge selbst voranbringen. Du hast eine Growth-Mentalität und möchtest nicht nur bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern neue Lösungen entwickeln. Du hast ein gutes kommerzielles Verständnis und kannst Dich in Kunden- und Partnerperspektiven hineinversetzen. Du fühlst Dich in einem Startup- oder Scaleup-Umfeld wohl und hast Lust, Strukturen mit aufzubauen. Consulting-Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber kein Muss – wichtiger sind Problemlösungskomp

Technical skills: Thermal analysis, Thermal management of typical spacecraft subsystems (structures, avionics, propulsion), and understanding of spacecraft thermal environments Experience: Proven experience (3+ years) with (Active) Thermal Control System development and procurement, hands-on experience with Thermal Testing, including Thermal Cycling, Thermal Vacuum and Thermal Balance tests Programming Skills: Proficiency with thermal software (Thermal Desktop, ESATAN), and in programming and data analysis (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C++). Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Feedback : Willingness to give proactive and mindful feedback across all company levels. Mindset: Passion for advancing sustainability in the space industry and highly motivated to work in a fast paced, autonomously driven, and demanding start-up environment. Languages: Fluent in English. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. title: Senior Project Manager
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp. Your Mission You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast. As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once. At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical. You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality. We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on. Your Career Path in Project Management This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires. Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost. Why is this role interesting? High-impact scope : You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers. Real ownership : You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery. Builder's playground : You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale. Tangible results : Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate. What will you do with us? You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you: Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness , several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure); Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives; Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on; Are confident with change management , including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating; Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them. Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did

To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights. The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan. Main missions include: Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs). Value proposition and pricing : Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment? Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management. P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L. Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights. We are currently hiring for new segments: It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built. description: Germany - EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity www.3ive.ai About Us A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next car component still clicks through CAD trees, up to 7 different softwares and searches Excel sheets, Windows folders and asks whoever has been around longest. AI is about to change that fundamentally – and nobody has figured out yet what the interface for it looks like. That is why we are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: agents that work natively in 3D, sit on top of CATIA, NX, SOLIDWORKS and Creo, and learn from real-world engineering decisions. There is no pattern library for this category yet – you will write it.
